model_type: Logistic Regression (via sklearn Pipeline with TF-IDF + OneHotEncoder + StandardScaler)

preprocessing.numeric_cleaning: coerce to numeric, fill NaN with 0 (inference) or median (training)

known_limitations: Trained on synthetic dataset (500 samples) — not real-world OCR output
May underperform on noisy OCR text or multilingual documents
Unknown file_type or source_system values are handled but reduce accuracy
Short extracted text (<50 chars) triggers quality gate and skips prediction
Does not handle image-only documents (requires OCR upstream)
intended_use: Classify document types from ingested file metadata and extracted text
Support document routing and organizational workflows
Provide metadata for RAG filtering by document type
Generate prediction logs for audit and analytics
not_intended_use: Not for classifying documents in languages other than English
Not for determining document authenticity or fraud detection
Not for sensitive or high-stakes legal classification without human review
Not for production deployment without retraining on real-world data

status_values.waiting_for_source: Extracted text too short or missing

author: Tuong
